item.name: Gate availability for a time window
Assign gate to flight (conflict-checked; re-assign = gate change)
Counter availability for a time window
Register passenger (synthetic data); optionally map to a flight
Check in passenger (validates flight, seat, counter; prevents duplicates; issues boarding pass)
Mark passenger boarded (flight must be BOARDING)
Update baggage lifecycle status (timestamped history row is recorded)
Register baggage (unique tag, weight limits per category)
Tasks assigned to the logged-in staff member
Turnaround activity plan with planned durations and prerequisites
Complete activity (delay_reason required if it overran)
Equipment availability for a time window
Assign equipment to a flight (availability + conflict validated)
Record a delay (give delay_minutes or updated_departure; flight -> DELAYED)
Delay history & total for a flight
Allocate gate / counter / staff / equipment to a flight (conflict-checked)
Resources free in a time window
Send an announcement to roles (or everyone)
